name: ci-closed-pulls
request: Scout's CI watcher sometimes reports a red build on a pull request that's already been merged or closed. It happens when a thread opens a newer pull request on the same branch: the old one still looks open in Scout's records, so the new pull request's failing checks get reported against it as well. Before acting on a pull request, the watcher should look at what the code host says about it now, and leave it alone if it isn't open any more.

check.suite: [ -d node_modules ] || npm ci --no-audit --no-fund >/dev/null 2>&1; node --test $(ls test/*.test.ts | grep -vx test/dash.test.ts)
